description: This Java class defines a specific implementation of a test scenario ('Scenario4MultipleSubjects20') for a policy enforcer within a testbench framework. It sets up a scenario involving multiple subjects with different permissions and provides methods to access the scenario setup and to apply a policy algorithm for permission checks.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects20
classes.description: A Java class implementing a test scenario involving multiple subjects with specified permissions and a method to evaluate a policy algorithm.
